text: Harness verify: re-run the executor's claimed commands deterministically and give the verifier the receipts
description: Before the verifier model runs, the harness itself re-runs each command the executor claims (through the guarded runCommand, with a time limit) and records exit code and output tail as receipts. The verifier sees the receipts next to the diff; a 'verified' verdict whose receipts include a failing command is downgraded to failed by code. RESEARCHED: arXiv 2605.18747 frames autonomous SE capability as the model-harness-environment system producing a verifiably correct change with harness-mediated evidence (https://arxiv.org/html/2605.18747); VeriHarness accepts only on receipts from deterministic checks (https://pypi.org/project/hoh/). OBSERVED: our own lesson in dfa5df09 — once a check is settled, model invocation adds variance without judgment. Distinct from 43166d16 (external verifier services): this is the in-harness deterministic layer those would sit on. Acceptance: unit tests for receipt collection and the downgrade rule; traces contain the receipts.

status.comment: cycle.ts collectReceipts re-runs up to 5 claimed commands through the guarded runCommand (120s limit) before the verifier; receipts (command, exit code, refused reason, 1.5k output tail) replace the bare command list in the verifier prompt and are stored in the cycle trace. stages.ts applyReceipts: a verified verdict with any failing non-refused receipt becomes failed with 'Overruled by the harness: re-run of the claimed command `…` exited N'; refused commands don't count; other verdicts stay. Evidence: stages.test (rule), cycle.test (receipt in trace and verifier prompt; `process.exit(3)` overrules verified -> idea stays open, no reflection), loop-worker 23/23; backend loop-cycle e2e 3/3 asserts the receipt reaches the real verifier request.
